conflicts.recommendation: spec1's analytics endpoints are read-only (SELECT queries). No conflict with spec2's learning data persistence.

mitigationSteps: Verify analytics queries use SELECT only (no UPDATE/DELETE)
Test learning loop still functions after analytics deployment
